entities.summary: Oleh's unification of Novgorod and Kyiv (882), Princess Olha's conversion to Christianity, Sviatoslav's military campaigns, and Volodymyr the Great's Baptism of Rus' (988) — the civilisational choice that oriented the East Slavic world toward Byzantine Christianity.
